content.title: Review product details and add an item to the cart
content.description: A shopper opens a product detail page to inspect buying information, must satisfy any required option selections before adding, receives confirmation when a valid product is added, and expects the chosen quantity to carry into the cart exactly as entered.
content.summary: Inspect a product and add it correctly.
content.value: Lets shoppers make a buying decision and place the intended item and quantity into the basket without corruption.
criteria: Opening a product from a listing shows product name, price, availability, and a quantity field.
Products with required options cannot be added until the options are selected, and the missing option is identified to the shopper.
Adding a valid product updates the header cart total and shows a success confirmation.
Adding quantity N results in quantity N in the cart, not 1.
